pages.content: Refund Policy | Tutorify Tutoring Refund Policy Last Updated: October 2025 1. Overview At Tutorify Tutoring , we strive to ensure customer satisfaction. If you are not satisfied with your purchase, please review our refund policy below. 2. Eligibility for Refunds Refund requests must be made within 14 days of purchase. Only unused or unaccessed courses are eligible for full refunds. Completed lessons or downloaded materials are non-refundable. 3. Non-Refundable Items Gift cards and promotional purchases. Special discounted bundles. 4. Refund Process To initiate a refund, contact us at support@tutorify.com with your order details. Approved refunds will be processed to your original payment method within 5–10 business days. 5. Contact Us For any refund-related questions, reach out via email at support@tutorify.com . 6.
